high_level_description:
Compose a landscape information graphic around a clearly legible horizontal group bar chart. The chart shows durability scores for <text 6> and <text 14> materials across years across the displayed periods.

At the right side, <chart 5> forms the dominant analytical focus. Inside it, the quantitative marks, labels, and structural guides remain visually coordinated.

Use <text 2> and <text 3> as the editorial entry point in the upper left, with a clear hierarchy of scale, weight, and spacing. Additional context comes from <image 124> at the middle left, <panel 125> at the lower left, <text 128> at the lower left, and <shape 4> at the upper left.

Finish the graphic with clean, modern editorial design with a focus on data clarity and typographic hierarchy over a flat full-canvas field. Let color and typography provide most of the contrast, with soft vector shadows reserved for layered objects.

style_description.aesthetics: Clean, modern editorial design with a focus on data clarity and typographic hierarchy. Uses a light background with high-contrast text for readability. Minimalist data visualization with a focus on clean lines and structured layout.
style_description.lighting: Flat, even lighting typical of digital editorial graphics. or gradients on text or icons.
